description: The Line Graph visual is a versatile tool for tracking trends over time. It supports multiple series, various interpolation methods (curved, linear, stepped), and advanced handling of missing data. It provides multiple interpolation modes including curved, linear, and stepped, along with smart handling of missing data points. You can emphasize main series against muted background lines and fully customize markers and strokes for a polished look. For more details visit the r42 site → Line Graph KEY FEATURES Line appearance and behavior Contextual line styling Layout control for small multiples Small multiples titling Easy card styling Global formatting control Native tooltips Comprehensive color management Advanced series management Direct series labeling Detailed data label control Flexible date axis configuration Interactive states and feedback Fully customizable metric axis Free visual All features of this visual are free, no license required. Updates Version 1.1 Added support for date hierarchies (year, quarter, month, day) Version 1.2 Added support for multiple metrics
